subject: general
question: The Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act, 2005 aims to provide ____ days of wage employment to every household to ensure livelihood security in rural areas.
solution:
The correct answer is **__100.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MNREGA) aims to enhance livelihood security in rural areas by providing at least 100 days of wage employment in a financial year to every household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.**
 
• Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MNREGA) is **an Indian labour law and social security measure that aims to guarantee the right to work.**
 
• The act was passed on** August 23, 2005. (under the prime ministership of Manmohan Singh).**
 
• The act was** first proposed in 1991 by PV.Narasimha Rao.**
 
• It was quoted as a **"Stellar Example of Rural Development" in World Development Report 2014.**
 
• The NDA Government had decided to provide 150 days in rain-hit areas.
 
• Employment is provided within 5 km of an applicant's residence.
 
• If work is not provided within 15 days of applying, applicants are entitled to an unemployment allowance.
 
• The registration process involves an application to the Gram Panchayat and the issue of Job cards.
 
• **MNREGA is implemented mainly by Gram Panchayats.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• The act aims to follow** Directive Principles of State Policy enunciated in Part 4** of the Constitution of India.
 
• **Article 41** directs the state to secure all the citizens'** right to Work.**
 
• The act also fulfills** Article 21 **of the Constitution of India which guarantees the** Right to Life with dignity to every citizen of India.**
